translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Kkepas Aeiineon Nemaeniaen Jesus
Eraaen igiwe Jesus e fenai ngaeniir aeremas me noan Temple we, e fenaiuw Kkepas Mwamwaai we, nge soamwooniir patere, me sinsein anniug me fengaen me rhooa kkewe ra tugufaeyi ra noa itto
nge ra aengaeni pwe, “Meeta nemaenioamw pwe wopwe feeori minikkeei? Iyo a ngaenneog oamw nemenem?”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Ipwe aeiineogaemi eew kkepas aeiineo. Oaw aengaeniaei,
iya e itto aaen John nemenem pwe epwe paptismus fetaen: saengi Deus aere saengi aeremas?”
Ra rhaepetae aar aengimaw fengaen wooar, “Meeta sipwe iura? Aere sipwe iura pwe, ‘Saengi Deus,’ nge iiy epwe aeiineogirh pwe, ‘Nge meeta rhag oawse niugiuniug ngaeni John reen?’
Nge aere sipwe iura pwe, ‘Saengi aeremas,’ ina nge pwuwaen aeremas eei nge repwene teragirh, pwe iga re niugiuniug pwe John nge erhai profeta.”
Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Aeise giuneei iga e itto me ee.”
Iwe nge Jesus a aengaeniir pwe, “Ina nge ngaang isoapw pwan aengaenigaemi iya iga i pwigi me ee nemaeniaei pwe ipwe feeori minikkeei.”
Fioangon Awewen Rhooan Aemmwenen Maat we
Iwe Jesus a aeni eew fioang awewe ngaeniir aeremas kkewe. “Eno erhai mwaaen a foatogi eew maetaen grape, nge a ngaenneer aaemweoi rhooan maat pwe repwe aefaenniy. Iwe rhag nge a saei taaw noa.

Enoa itto oatowe repwe giniiy uwaen waniwan kkewe, a fangenoa erhai rhooan akkiuneo pwe epwe noa pwigi wiwiin me reen uwaen maat kkewe. Nge rhooan maat kkewe ra wirhiy nge ra aesefaaeni noa nge esooar meeta e pwigi.
Iwe a pwan fangenoa erhai rhooan akkiuneo; rhooan maat kkewe ra pwan noa wirhiy nge ra feeori ngaeni aekkaew wegitaeg aessaew nge re aesefaaeni noa nge esooar meeta e pwigi.
A pwan fangenoa aeiniurhaiun rhooan akkiuneo kkewe; rhooan maat kkewe ra pwan oawoasu nge re aerheiwow niugiun maat we.
Manewe aan maat we a iura pwe, ‘Meeta minne ipwene feeori? Maeni ipwene fangenoa aeterhaeng e naeyi; e tiwegin nge repwe aesirowu!’

Nge igiwe rhooan maat we ra weri, ra pwiungiuw fengaenniy wooar pwe, ‘Ieei mwaaen we naiun mwaaen we aan maat eei iwe epwe pwugusaeni minneei. Oaw itto sipwe niiy noa, pwe sipwe pwigi minne pwugusaen pwe pwugusarh!’
Iwe ra oatorawow niugiun maat we nge ra niiy noa.” Jesus a aeiineeor pwe, “Meeta manewe aan maat we epwe feeori ngaeniir rhooan maenemaen kkewe?
Epwe itto a itto niir noa mwaaen kkewe, nge a ngaenneer aaemweoi maat we.” Igiwe aeremas ra rongorong minneei nge ra iura pwe, “Aapw saapw ina!”
Jesus a wegitaeg ngaeniir nge a aeiineeor pwe, “Iwe ina nge meeta awewen miniwe noan Pwapwior we e Santus?

content.text: ‘Fai we rhooan kaiu iimw re aerheei noa,
nge faer ina fai we egin yor ipitan me mmwaen oanongan.’

content: Oanongeer rhooakka repwe ppiungiutiw wooan faai een nge repwe mwetoarotoar noa; nge aere faai een epwe ppiungiutiw wooan erhai, epwe aepettatiw.”
Kkepas Aeiineon Tax
Sinsein anniug me soamwoonin patere kkewe ra mwerhaen repwe torofi Jesus, pwe igiwe re giuneei pwe fioangoor miniwe a aengaeniir; nge igiwe re mesagiiur aeremas kkewe.

Iwe ra weti ngaeni eew oat ne repwe mmwenen torofi. Ra fang ngaeniir aaemweoi mwaaen senaapiy pwe repwe noa feeoriir noa pwe iir aaemweoi mwaaen wenewen, iwe ra fangenoa iir pwe repwe noa oatupwu Jesus pwe repwe torofi reen aan kkepas pwe epwe mmwen pwe repwe fangenoa iiy reen Governor reen Rome ina eyor maemaewan.

Iwe aeremas kkewe ra aengaeni Jesus pwe, “Sinsei, aei giuneei pwe minikkomwu wo aepesa nge e wenewen. Aei giuneei pwe een wose aefaenniy wunuunun erhai me erhai, nge wa fenaiuw wenewenen nee tipaen Deus ngaeniir aeremas.
Aengaenigemaem, e mwamwaai aarh sipwe fang tax ngaeni Soamwoonin Rome, aere aapw?”
Jesus e metefaaegini oatupwutupw we aar nge a aengaeniir pwe,
“Pwaerito efai senaapiy silver. Mesaen iyo me itaen iyo imwu eno wooan?” Ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Soamwoonin Rome.”
Jesus a iura pwe, “Iwe ina nge oaw ngaenneei Soamwoonin Rome meeta aaen Soamwoonin Rome, nge oaw ngaenneei Deus meeta aaen Deus.”

Iwe esooar meeta ne emmwen pwe repwe torofi Jesus reen petenaen kkepas kkewe e paniuwaeni ngaeniir me weni mmweer rhooa towunap we, iwe ra anniug noa rhag pwe ra mwaar reen sefaaenin kkepas kkewe aan.
Kkepas Aeiineon Menaw Sefaaen
Aaemweoi Sadducees, iwe re iura pwe esooar menaw sefaaen me reen mae, ra itto aengaeni Jesus pwe,

“Sinsei, Moses minne e foatogi anniug eei pwe aemaem: ‘Aere erhai mwaaen a mae nge esooar naiun wooan rhooapwut we pwiuniuwan, ina nge mwaaen we pwiin epwe pwiuniuwaeni rhooapwut we pwe epwe yor naiun pwe epwe ffai pwe naiun mwaaen we a mae.’
Reno fiusiuman pwipwi; mwaaen we e tugufaeyi a pwiuniuwaeni nge emae noa nge esooar naiun.
Iwe ariiurhaiun a pwan pwiuniuwaeni rhooapwut we,
pwan ina rhag iwe aeiniurhaiun. Oanongeer me fiusiuman nge ina rhag miniwe ewen ngaeniir. Remae noa nge esooar naiiur.
Mwirin noan, nge rhooapwut we a maenoa.
Iwe igina, wooan raaenin na manimae repwene menaw sefaaen, iyo me neeiir epwe pwiuniuwaeni rhooapwut we? Pwe igiwe rhooawe fiusiuman nge re pwiuniuwaeni niewe.”
Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Mwaaen me rhooapwuton faaen mweoiuw nge re rhooan ngaenne,
iwe nge mwaaen me rhooapwut kena ra ffin tae pwe repwe menaw sefaaen iwe nge ra no noan mweoi na epwe noa itto nge ina resoapw rhiuwen pwiuppwiuniuw.
Iir repwene weei rhag angkenus pwe resoapw mmwenen mae. Ra no pwe naiun Deus pwe ra menaw sefaaen me reen maenoa.

Moses a aeffeta noa pwe manimae nge re menaw sefaaen tae. Me reen petenaen fioangon waniwan we e ppwunuwow aengaet me reen iwe e aepesa kkepesaen Soamwoon pwe, ‘aaen Abraham Deus, aaen Isaac Deus, me aaen Jacob Deus.’
Pwe iiy minne aar Deus rhooakka re menaw nge soapw rhooakka ra mae, pwe me reen nge oanongeer aeremas nge re menaw me reen.”
Aekkaaemweoi me neeiir sinsein anniug we ra mwaenieniy tae, “Sinsei, e igin gacch aessefaaenin kkepas we oamw!”
Pwe iir ra mesag pwe repwe aeiineo mwo nge eew kkepas aeiineo.
Kkepas Aeiineon Iyo na Kristus
Jesus a aeiineeor pwe, “Meeta emmwen pwe re iura pwe Kristus nge teoteeon David reen?
Pwe David wooan oanongan nge e iura me noan pwapwior we Psalms,

content.text: toori aaei ipwe iseniir tiw rhooan oapwutoag faaen pirhemw
pwe repwe no pwe nenien pirhemw.’

content: David e faingi pwe iiy ‘Soamwoon’; iwe nge e ifa wusun nge Kristus epwe no pwe teoteeon David?”
Jesus a Atapeonneogiiur Reen Sinsein Anniug Kkewe
Igiwe aeremas re aiussaening ngaeni nge Jesus a aengaeniir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe,

“Oaw aefaennigaemi reen sinsein anniug kkewe, re aerhaengi aar faaeraeg fetaen faaen mengaagiiur min enaenaei, nge re aerhaengi aar aeremas repwe aewenimmwaar me aesirowuur me noan imwaen chuwaai, nge re fini rhag neniy kkena nenieer rhooa taegias me noan wutteer Jews me pwiuneoi mwamwaai me noan gupwun.
Re oapwurhaar rhooapwut kkewe ra mae pwiuniuweer, nge ra pirifa saengiir pwuguseer, nge ra oangona ngaeniir aeremas aar maeipin enaei! Iwe nge aegaeregaeriir ina epwene igin waeiraes!”
